rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=2.5, img_sy=2.5, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=123, rationale=iter-16, CEILING-DOCUMENTATION confirmation probe. ONE-KNOB change vs the iter-12 CHAMPION base (SSIM 0.974822, PSNR 38.63 dB; proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=0.0005, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, img_sx=img_sy=2.5, n_iter=300, seed=42). KNOB: seed 42 -> 123 (isolated). This is an HONEST CONFIRMATION PROBE, not a ceiling-raiser: ALL knob families are now exhausted -- IMAGE-domain (range img_sr tight peak, depth img_n_bf=3 peak, kernel img_kernel 7->9 flat, spatial img_sx/img_sy full 0.5/1.5/2.5/3.5 sweep flat) and PROJECTION-domain (range proj_sr=0.0005 peak / 0.0001 flat, depth proj_n_bf=2 flat, spatial proj_sx 1.0->0.5 DOWN @iter-14, proj_sy 2.0->0.5 flat @iter-15), plus n_iter and pretrain_epochs. The ENTIRE search ran at seed=42; a seed flip is the canonical confirmation probe -- it tests whether the 0.9748 ceiling is seed-ROBUST (init / train-subset-sampling / per-scan-optimization-invariant) rather than an artefact of one seed lottery. EVERYTHING else identical to the iter-12 champion (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=img_sy=2.5; proj_sx/proj_sy/img_kernel/proj_kernel at Wagner-abdomen defaults). FAILURE MODE at 0.9748: the 12-param bilateral is at its breast FBP-bounded representational ceiling; hr=0, PSNR ~38.63 pinned ~1 dB under the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline -- the BF inductive bias approaches but cannot beat a clean 128-view breast FBP (mirroring dd-bf-supervised 0.9502 on Mayo). HYPOTHESIS: a seed flip 42->123 lands SSIM at ~0.9748 (within +-0.0005 of the iter-12 champion). The 12-param bilateral has too few DOF to be seed-sensitive (only 12 sigma scalars warm-started from an amortized N2I init, then per-scan-fit on each image's OWN measurements -- no pixel-wise memory, no large param space for the seed to swing), so the seed should reproduce the ceiling, CONFIRMING 0.9748 is a substrate property (breast 128-view FBP bound) not a seed lottery. If instead SSIM swings by >0.0005, the per-scan fit has a seed-dependent noise floor (as demo-n2i's U-Net does, where a seed flip alone swung 0.5081->0.4203) and the bilateral ceiling reads are noisier than assumed -- but the 12-param bilateral physically cannot overfit one scan, so a tight reproduction is expected. WALL: step budget IDENTICAL to iter-12 (n_iter=300, val_n=16; warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800); iter-12 ran 497 s, iter-15 ran 495 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged. ONE knob changed: seed 42->123 (isolated).
